fatal_blockers: Proposal 1 does not specify the constraint complex, cycle-word homomorphism, lifted binary matrix, or a deterministic polynomial bound on p. PSL2(F5) can certify nonidentity only on the tiny test; it supplies no Hamming-spread mechanism, and fixed-group nonzeroness cannot establish polynomial support.

Proposal 2 leaves the route-intersection checks and binary syndrome map undefined. Whole-route columns do not prevent constant-size rectangle splices or odd route superpositions, and the padded q=4 experiment cannot discriminate the claimed asymptotic unique-neighbor mechanism.

Proposal 3 requires constructing an isolated matching center without solving the source problem. Hashes into F2^2 cannot isolate arbitrary witness families, the constant-distance [7,4,3] selector cannot yield polynomial separation, and cross-sector XORs remain unaddressed.

Proposal 4's length-four residual truncation is a bounded-degree signature and therefore remains vulnerable to larger cube relations under O1. Exact residual/Hankel separation can require exponential rank, while the proposed F4 matrices and binary expansion are not specified.

Proposal 5 has a direct ratio ceiling: an odd XOR of three legal one-hot chart vectors occupies at most three cells per chart versus one for a legal vector. Adding charts cannot turn that hostile word into a polynomial-factor separation; recursive chart coding is unspecified and risks the proved superpolynomial rank wall.

Proposal 6 is the only proposal aimed at the surviving code-dependent-fold opening, but it is not precommitted: the polynomial labels, univariate embedding, annihilator computation, greedy objective, budget, and tie-breaking are absent. Commutative multiplication and all CRT/Hasse reductions identify (i,j) with (j,i), leaving a structural mixed-tensor kernel; avoiding its pointed secants is assumed rather than proved and may require nearest-word information.

Proposal 7 confuses Fourier/discrepancy spread with minimum binary Hamming support. The complete character table gives a large legal baseline, fixed gadgets retain larger-cube relations, and no explicit binary map or every-mixed-word lower bound is supplied.

None of the proposals provides an arbitrary-instance polynomial-time binary H,t, a uniform sparse YES bound, a larger all-mixed-word NO bound, and exact output-rank accounting. O8 therefore remains only a conditional transfer and cannot rescue any proposal.
evidence: The frozen commutative truncated-algebra fold had worst YES 4 versus best NO 2, and all-eight produced a corner-only pointed word. This directly undermines Proposal 6's multiplication premise, although it is not a theorem against every code-dependent algebra.

Noncommutative and dense alternatives also failed on support: the M3(F4) fold had pointed kernels, the F8 condenser gave 31 versus 6, and the A4 convolution gave 20 versus 10. These verifiers show that nonzeroness, rank, holonomy, or mixing do not imply useful Hamming distance.

The Schur-walk verifier found all-eight and holonomy illegal mixed words of costs 6 and 9 with the entire nonlinear shell canceled. This is direct hostile evidence against route, chart, pointer, and holonomy mechanisms lacking a new affine-closure invariant.

The sampled product fold initially showed a finite gap but collapsed on frozen held-out families; generator-type puncturing also lost the gap. Proposal 6's unspecified greedy modulus selection would repeat that overfitting risk.

The exchange-quotient verifier found illegal covers in the affine span of legal matchings, while prior global-selector experiments admitted cross-branch splices. This blocks the isolation-sector proposal absent a genuinely nonlinear, computable canonical selector.

No supplied verifier implements any of these seven proposals, so none of their predicted improvements has experimental support. Existing finite failures must not be promoted to universal no-go theorems, but they invalidate the stated causal justifications.
next_experiment: No implementation is authorized as written. Proposal 6 may be revived only after freezing an explicit polynomial-time label embedding, CRT/Hasse matrix, output budget, and lexicographic selection rule using only computable star-zero linear invariants; then enumerate every pointed mixed image word on held-out YES/NO, affine-closure, all-eight, and holonomy families, rejecting on any pointed kernel, hostile distance not above worst YES, use of nearest-word computation, or failure to beat the unfurled rank exponent.
